CommunityApplications.Profile: Community Applications maintained by 2CrAzYTV for Unraid. This repository contains Multi-Coin Paper Daytrader, a paper-only crypto trading simulator; Alarm-HUB, a standalone multi-user alarm service with embedded PostgreSQL and optional WebComm integration; and WebComm Calendar Sync, a duty-plan synchronization service with ICS, CalDAV, Google Calendar, Telegram and optional Alarm-HUB integration. Multi-Coin Paper Daytrader cannot place real-money orders, does not provide personalized investment advice, makes no profit or return guarantee, produces simulated paper signals only, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Bitpanda. Each application links to its own public project repository for documentation, support and source code.
